narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a street interview exploring the 'lying flat' phenomenon among Singaporean youth, contrasting it with the local 'kiasu' (fear of losing out) culture. It aims to showcase the interviewee's personal determination and resilience despite significant past hardships like gambling debt and orphanhood.
